source: Do not restart the computer unless support asks you to. If the upload fails, keep the error message and retry once.
critical_semantic_predicates: Restarting is prohibited except when support requests it.
Keeping the error message and retrying once apply if the upload fails.
Retry is once, not repeated indefinitely.
legitimate_variations: Natural French phrasing of unless/except is allowed.
Support may be rendered as technical support.

source: You may open the document only after the owner approves. If approval is missing, do not share the link.
critical_semantic_predicates: Opening requires prior approval from the owner.
Lack of approval prohibits sharing the link.
The text does not say that approval has already been given.
legitimate_variations: Natural Arabic grammatical gender/address is allowed when consistent.
Approval and authorisation can use equivalent wording.

source: It is not impossible to finish today, but I cannot promise that we will. Please do not tell the client it is guaranteed.
critical_semantic_predicates: Finishing today is possible, not impossible.
The speaker makes no promise that completion will happen.
The client must not be told completion is guaranteed.
legitimate_variations: Not impossible can naturally become possible if the reservation is retained.
Formal or informal address is allowed.

source: I cannot confirm that the package contains no damaged items. This does not mean that damage has been found.
critical_semantic_predicates: The absence of damage is unconfirmed.
The statement does not assert that damage exists or has been found.
Uncertainty about absence must not become certainty of presence.
legitimate_variations: Natural Persian restructuring is allowed if both uncertainty statements remain.

source: Submit the form by 17:00 on 12 March 2027, unless we extend the deadline in writing. A verbal promise does not change the deadline.
critical_semantic_predicates: The deadline is 17:00 on 12 March 2027.
A written extension can change the deadline.
A verbal promise alone does not change it.
legitimate_variations: 17h00 or an unambiguous equivalent of 5 p.m. is allowed.
Natural Portugal Portuguese date order and phrasing are allowed.

source: If the indicator is green, press START. If it is red or flashing, do not press START; ask the technician.
critical_semantic_predicates: A green indicator permits pressing START.
Red OR flashing is sufficient to prohibit pressing START; the conditions must not become red AND flashing.
The prohibited case requires asking the technician.
legitimate_variations: Natural Chinese conditional structure is allowed.
START can be kept as the button label, with a translated explanation if desired.
review_notes: The capitalised label identifies a control; compare its identity, not exact surrounding wording.

source: Let's call it a day. We can pick this up tomorrow; nobody is asking you to make a phone call.
critical_semantic_predicates: The speaker proposes stopping the current work for today.
The work can resume tomorrow.
No phone call is being requested.
legitimate_variations: A natural French idiom or a clear paraphrase is acceptable.
The English idiom does not need a literal word-for-word rendering.

source: The ball is in your court now: we have sent the draft, and the next decision is yours. There is no sports meeting.
critical_semantic_predicates: The draft has already been sent by the speaker/group.
The recipient now has responsibility for the next decision.
The phrase is not an instruction about a real ball or sports meeting.
legitimate_variations: A natural Turkish idiom or explanation of responsibility is acceptable.

source: The deadline is tomorrow, so please do not put this on the back burner. Give it attention today.
critical_semantic_predicates: The deadline is tomorrow.
The recipient should give the task attention today rather than postpone it.
No cooking appliance is involved.
legitimate_variations: A Japanese paraphrase expressing priority is acceptable.
Politeness can be natural rather than literally mirroring English.

source: Could you please send a clear photo when you have a moment? There is no need to apologise, and it is fine to ask for help.
critical_semantic_predicates: A clear photo is requested politely, with flexible timing.
An apology is not required.
Asking for help is permitted and welcome.
legitimate_variations: Natural Portugal Portuguese politeness and address are allowed.
The request must not gain an urgent deadline.

source: Thank you for the invitation. I am sorry, but I will not be able to attend. I hope the event goes well.
critical_semantic_predicates: The speaker expresses thanks and regret.
The speaker will not attend; this must not become acceptance or a tentative promise to attend.
The event receives a positive wish without an invented explanation for absence.
legitimate_variations: Natural Spanish politeness and future phrasing are allowed.

source: I am sorry this has been stressful. You do not have to decide today. We can talk again tomorrow if you would like.
critical_semantic_predicates: The speaker acknowledges stress sympathetically.
A decision today is not required.
Another conversation tomorrow is optional, not an imposed appointment.
legitimate_variations: Natural Arabic address and gender choices are allowed.
Equivalent sympathetic wording is acceptable.

source: I understand that you are upset. I can discuss the issue calmly, but I cannot continue the conversation if you shout at me.
critical_semantic_predicates: The speaker acknowledges the other person is upset.
Calm discussion remains possible.
Shouting at the speaker is the condition under which the conversation cannot continue.
legitimate_variations: Formal or familiar French address is allowed if consistent.
The conditional boundary must not become a blanket refusal to discuss the issue.

source: Alex told Sam that they would call after the meeting.
critical_semantic_predicates: Alex communicates something to Sam.
A call is expected after, not before, the meeting.
The source does not uniquely identify the caller or resolve singular/plural they.
legitimate_variations: Different plausible antecedent or number choices may be grammatically necessary.
A translation that retains the ambiguity naturally is welcome but not mandatory.
review_notes: Do not rank an interpretation as uniquely correct without more source context. Record which actor/number the output chooses and whether source clarification would be useful.

source: Morgan thanked Casey because they had helped with the report.
critical_semantic_predicates: Morgan thanks Casey.
Help with the report is the stated reason for the thanks.
The source leaves the grammatical reference of they underdetermined.
legitimate_variations: Japanese can naturally omit an explicit pronoun.
Casey as helper is a plausible reading, but the source alone is not a unique gold standard.
review_notes: Record any resolved actor as an interpretation. Do not pretend the translation engine can establish the author’s intended antecedent.

source: The call starts at 09:30 London time on 6 July 2027. Please join 10 minutes early. Do not convert the time to another time zone.
critical_semantic_predicates: The call starts at 09:30 in London local time on 6 July 2027.
The recipient should join 10 minutes before that start.
The time must not be converted to a different zone or labelled with an assumed fixed UTC offset.
legitimate_variations: 09h30 or an unambiguous equivalent is allowed.
The date can use natural French ordering.

source: The label reads '04/05/2027'. Keep that date exactly as printed; the order of day and month has not been confirmed.
critical_semantic_predicates: 04/05/2027 is retained exactly.
The day/month order remains unconfirmed.
The output must not silently resolve the date as either 4 May or April 5.
legitimate_variations: Japanese quotation marks and explanatory phrasing may differ.

source: The train leaves at 23:45 on Friday and arrives at 00:20 on Saturday. The arrival is the next day, not Friday.
critical_semantic_predicates: Departure is Friday at 23:45.
Arrival is Saturday at 00:20.
Arrival occurs on the next calendar day, not on Friday.
legitimate_variations: Natural Turkish weekday/date-time wording is allowed.
Unambiguous 12-hour equivalents are allowed if midnight/day identity is preserved.

source: Choose Settings > Storage, then select 'Export a copy'. Do not choose 'Delete all data'. If error E_CONN_204 appears, leave the window open.
critical_semantic_predicates: The navigation path is Settings then Storage.
The action is exporting a copy, while deleting all data is prohibited.
E_CONN_204 is retained exactly.
The window should remain open if that error appears.
legitimate_variations: UI label translations are allowed if their functions remain unmistakable.
Labels may retain English alongside Chinese.

source: After saving the file, disconnect the USB drive. If the file is still being copied, wait until copying has finished before disconnecting it.
critical_semantic_predicates: Saving precedes disconnection.
A drive must not be disconnected while copying remains in progress.
Disconnection becomes permissible after copying has finished.
legitimate_variations: Natural Persian ordering of the two instructions is allowed.
USB may remain a technical abbreviation.

source: The draft clause says: "The tenant may end the agreement with 30 days' written notice." This is quoted text for translation, not a request for advice.
critical_semantic_predicates: The tenant, not the landlord, is the actor permitted to end the agreement.
May expresses permission, not a duty to terminate.
The condition is 30 days of written notice, not oral notice or a different duration.
The statement is identified as a quotation from a draft, not advice.
legitimate_variations: French quotation marks and natural contract vocabulary are allowed.
No governing jurisdiction or legal validity needs to be invented.
review_notes: Synthetic language test only; no legal advice or claim about enforceability.

source: Translate this sentence from a draft: "The supplier is liable only for direct losses, except where a court determines otherwise." Keep the exception attached to the limitation.
critical_semantic_predicates: The supplier is the actor described as liable.
The ordinary limitation concerns direct losses only.
A contrary court determination is an exception to that limitation.
The output must not remove the exception or make indirect losses unconditionally included.
legitimate_variations: Natural Arabic draft-clause wording and quotation marks are allowed.
review_notes: Synthetic quoted wording; no legal validity or real-world rule is being assessed.

source: Your appointment is at 10:15 on Monday. Please use the side entrance and check in at reception. If you need step-free access, call the number on the invitation before you travel.
critical_semantic_predicates: The appointment is Monday at 10:15.
Arrival uses the side entrance and reception check-in.
Calling before travel is conditional on needing step-free access.
The telephone number is the one on the invitation; no new number or treatment direction is invented.
legitimate_variations: Unambiguous Spanish time formatting is allowed.
An equivalent accessibility phrase without steps is acceptable.
review_notes: Arrival and accessibility instructions only; not medical advice.

category: Appointment documents and negated medication advice
source: For the appointment, bring the referral letter and the current medicine list. This message gives arrival instructions only; it does not tell you to start, stop, or change any medicine.
critical_semantic_predicates: Both a referral letter and the current medicine list should be brought.
The message describes arrival logistics only.
Starting, stopping and changing medicine are all explicitly outside the instruction.
The translation must not add a medication direction.
legitimate_variations: Natural Chinese words for referral and medication list are allowed.
review_notes: Synthetic non-advice message; no treatment recommendations are present.

category: Paragraph structure, list order and literal code
source:
Case GF-4821

Keep this text exactly: config_key=user_id

1. Save the draft.
2. Export a copy.
3. Do not delete the original.

Send the exported copy to review@example.com.
critical_semantic_predicates: GF-4821, config_key=user_id and review@example.com are retained exactly.
The ordered actions are saving the draft, exporting a copy, and not deleting the original.
Only the exported copy is sent to the stated email address.
The heading, code instruction, ordered list and destination remain distinguishable as blocks.
legitimate_variations: Turkish surrounding prose and equivalent list punctuation are allowed.
Blank-line counts may vary; merging the code, list and address into an ambiguous instruction is not acceptable.

source: من فضلك، لا تلغِ الموعد قبل أن تتواصل معي. يمكنك تأجيله إذا اتفقنا على وقت آخر.
critical_semantic_predicates: The recipient is politely asked not to cancel before contacting the speaker.
Postponement is permitted if both agree on another time.
Postponing and cancelling remain distinct actions.
legitimate_variations: Polite natural English is allowed.
Reschedule/postpone can use equivalent wording if the agreement condition remains.

source: اگر فایل هنوز کپی می‌شود، حافظهٔ USB را جدا نکنید. بعد از پایان کپی، می‌توانید آن را جدا کنید.
critical_semantic_predicates: The USB drive must not be disconnected while the file is still being copied.
Disconnection is permitted after copying completes.
The first prohibition is conditional, not a permanent ban.
legitimate_variations: USB drive, USB storage device or equivalent English is allowed.

source: Não é obrigatório cancelar a reserva. Só a cancele se tiver a certeza de que não vai utilizá-la.
critical_semantic_predicates: Cancelling the reservation is not obligatory.
Cancellation is advised only if the recipient is certain they will not use it.
No obligation to cancel or absolute prohibition on cancelling is introduced.
legitimate_variations: Natural English obligation/permission wording is allowed.

source: You need not cancel the appointment. You must not change its time without checking with the organiser.
critical_semantic_predicates: Cancelling is not required; it is not described as forbidden.
Changing the time without consulting the organiser is prohibited.
The two modal scopes and their different actions remain distinct.
legitimate_variations: Natural French phrasing of lack of obligation and prohibition is allowed.
Organiser/organizer spelling or equivalent role wording can vary.

source: Pay each of the 3 people £12.50. Do not treat £12.50 as the total for the whole group.
critical_semantic_predicates: There are 3 recipients.
Each recipient receives GBP 12.50.
GBP 12.50 must not become the combined payment for the group.
The negative clarification applies to treating the amount as a group total.
legitimate_variations: Arabic digits and unambiguous decimal formatting are allowed.
A correct written-out sterling amount is acceptable; no calculated group total needs to be added.
review_notes: Identical numeric tokens can coexist with a wrong allocation relationship; token agreement alone cannot establish this predicate.
